integrity: The all-degree claim is supported by a Fourier-block proof and scalar strict-concavity argument. A separately runnable finite diagnostic checker is included; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Determinant optimality applies only to two concentric, regular, equal-population polygon orbits, not arbitrary point sets.
Optimal outer radius is on the closed disk boundary; interior-only designs have the same unattained supremum.
The determinant criterion is not equivalent to optimizing the least singular value or worst-case reconstruction error.
Absolute historical priority has not been established; related general interpolation or Fekete results may imply an equivalent statement.
title: Unique D-optimal two-ring interpolation of bianalytic disk polynomials
